limitations: User-Agent probes originate from this environment, not authenticated crawler IPs. A 200 response cannot prove a real crawler visited or was allowed by IP/WAF policies.
Robots access and technical indexability do not prove current Google/Bing index state, sitemap processing, ranking, recommendation by an AI system or favicon presentation in search.
No Search Console/API was queried here. Existing index/request facts are historical and are not inferred from this audit.
TLS certificates were validated with standard platform verification; no insecure overrides were used.
Cache headers were observed only; no cache purge or provider settings were changed.
Recorded deploy identification comes from local documentation plus equal immutable permalink body, not an authenticated active-deploy query.
No contact was submitted; HTML contact destinations were observed only.

observedBlockers.interpretation: No blocker demonstrated if HTTP status/indexability/resource checks pass. Absence of a challenge for these probes does not rule out crawler-IP-based policies.
